📊 Example Output

🎯 Enterprise Manufacturing: S/4HANA Cloud Modernization

ICP for mid-to-large manufacturers with legacy ERP seeking cloud transformation

Discrete & Process Manufacturing
2,000 - 15,000 employees
$500M - $5B annually
North America, EMEA (DACH)
On-prem ERP, transitioning to cloud
ECC 6.0 (end of support 2027)

📝 Segment Overview

This segment represents mid-to-large discrete and process manufacturers currently running SAP ECC 6.0 who face an urgent modernization imperative. With SAP's 2027 end-of-support deadline approaching, these organizations must decide between RISE with SAP, a greenfield S/4HANA Cloud implementation, or a brownfield conversion.

These companies typically have 15-25 year SAP investments with significant customization. They're running mission-critical processes—MRP, shop floor control, quality management—that cannot tolerate extended downtime. Many have bolt-on best-of-breed solutions (Salesforce for CRM, Coupa for procurement) that complicate the migration story.

The buying motion is complex: 12-18 month sales cycles involving 8-12 stakeholders. CFOs are budget-constrained post-pandemic but recognize technical debt costs. CIOs are weighing "lift and shift" vs. "reimagine" approaches. Plant managers worry about production disruption during cutover.

🧭 How to Approach This Segment

💡 Lead with Business Outcomes

Don't talk cloud migration—talk inventory optimization, faster close cycles, and supply chain resilience. Quantify the cost of staying on ECC.

⚡ Address Migration Fear

Acknowledge the pain of past implementations. Lead with RISE's managed services model and SAP's Fit-to-Standard approach to reduce customization debt.

🤝 Engage Early with IT

IT teams are skeptical of "big bang" migrations. Show incremental paths: start with Finance, prove value, then expand to manufacturing modules.

📊 Arm the Champion

Internal sponsors need ROI ammunition. Provide industry-specific TCO models and peer reference stories (similar company, similar journey).

👥 Buying Committee

👔

CIO / VP IT

Decision Maker
Key Concerns
  • Integration with existing landscape
  • Migration risk and timeline
  • Total cost of ownership over 5 years
  • Talent: can we support S/4 in-house?
💰

CFO / VP Finance

Decision Maker
Key Concerns
  • Capital vs. operating expense model
  • Business case and payback period
  • Close cycle improvements
  • Audit and compliance benefits
🏭

VP Operations / Plant Manager

Key Influencer
Key Concerns
  • Production continuity during cutover
  • Shop floor integration (MES, IoT)
  • User training and adoption
  • Real-time visibility improvements
📋

VP Supply Chain

Key Influencer
Key Concerns
  • Demand sensing and forecasting
  • Supplier collaboration capabilities
  • Inventory optimization gains
  • Integration with logistics partners

Pull relevant sales plays, solution briefs, and competitive battlecards for this segment.

"Show me manufacturing modernization content for DACH region"

🏆 Golden Asset Finder

Surface top-performing assets (decks, one-pagers) that resonate with this ICP.

📊 Win/Loss Intelligence

🤝 Reference Customers

Find peer references—similar industry, size, and journey—to build credibility.

"Find $2B+ manufacturers who moved from ECC to S/4 Cloud"

✅ Strategic Recommendations

  1. 1 Lead with 2027 urgency — Frame as a business continuity conversation, not a technology upgrade. "What's your plan for ECC end-of-support?"
  2. 2 Offer an assessment — Propose a free ECC-to-S/4 readiness assessment to get technical teams engaged and build a business case together.
  3. 3 Bundle with BTP — Position Business Technology Platform as the integration layer that protects existing investments while enabling cloud benefits.
  4. 4 Reference RISE economics — Show how RISE with SAP's subscription model spreads cost and includes services that would otherwise require separate contracts.
  5. 5 Engage partners early — Manufacturing migrations need SI expertise. Loop in Accenture, Deloitte, or boutique manufacturing specialists based on account relationships.

Include firmographics, key personas in the buying committee, their specific concerns, and strategic recommendations for how to approach this segment. Pull relevant content from Knowledge@SAP."

What You'll Get

Pro Tips
